item.title: vscode: Visual Studio Code 1.146 (Insiders)
item.description:
The provided content only indicates that Visual Studio Code 1.146 (Insiders) has been published and links to the full release article. No feature or fix details are included in the supplied text.

  • Source: VS Code Updates and Blog

item.title: visualstudio: Copilot in Visual Studio Just Got a Major Upgrade
item.description:
Copilot Chat in Visual Studio now uses the Microsoft Copilot SDK starting with Visual Studio 2026 version 18.12. It is enabled by default and is described as a major upgrade with broader task coverage using the same models.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: dotnet: Delivering Skills in NuGet packages
item.description:
The post says agent skills can be packaged and delivered through NuGet packages to provide models with up-to-date library documentation.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: Announcing: Choose Your Own Telephony (CYOT) for Microsoft Entra
item.description:
Microsoft Entra ID will offer Choose Your Own Telephony Provider starting October 30, 2026. The feature lets organizations use a supported third-party telecom provider for SMS and voice authentication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: visualstudio: Stop waiting on a failed build
item.description:
Visual Studio now stops solution builds after the first project failure, so you can return to fixing the error sooner. The change reduces time spent waiting for the rest of the build to finish after an error has already occurred.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: Discover local models in GitHub Copilot CLI
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI version 1.0.94-0 adds a /model command so you can discover supported local models from within the CLI instead of leaving your workflow.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Stateless GitHub App installation tokens rolled out
item.description:
GitHub has completed the staged rollout of the stateless GitHub App installation token format. By default, newly minted installation tokens now use the new format.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: dotnet: Microsoft is updating its author-signing certificate starting September 23, 2026
item.description:
Microsoft will update the author-signing certificate used for NuGet packages on September 23, 2026. Users who rely on trusted signer policies or certificate fingerprint verification should add the new certificate before then.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: Manage the code coverage ruleset condition with the REST API
item.description:
GitHub now supports managing the “Restrict code coverage” repository ruleset option through the generally available REST API, in addition to the existing UI. This lets admins enforce code coverage requirements programmatically.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: Announcing: Azure Copilot introduces direct access to agents
item.description:
Starting in August 2026, Azure Copilot will let customers interact directly with agents to move from questions to actions faster. Users can choose the agent best suited to their goal.

  • Source: Azure Updates
